env-panes-pane.report: Panes has no generic pane: its panes are env-panes-main and env-panes-supporting, or env-panes-list and env-panes-detail.

env-panes.report: Panes sets no data-resizing while dragging: the divider has data-dragging, so write .env-panes:has(> .env-panes-divider[data-dragging]).
